## About
Naylor Automotive Engineering started as a family business when Richard 'Dick' Naylor and his son Glenn began selling automotive cores and moved into clutch remanufacturing. Over the years the shop grew into heavy-duty truck clutch, brake, transmission and differential work, along with friction material bonding for industrial customers.
Today the company is led by Paul Januska, and we work out of our facility at 4645 South Knox Avenue in the heart of Chicago's industrial south side. We are one of the last remaining clutch remanufacturers in the Northern Illinois area.
We serve commercial transportation, utilities, construction, off-highway, airports, automotive service dealers, and resale and retail dealers. Remanufacturing existing parts is a more economical alternative to buying new, and it keeps good material in use. Customers rate us 4.8 from 42 Google reviews.

## Services
- Truck transmission rebuilding: Remanufactured transmissions for medium and heavy duty trucks.
- Truck clutches and clutch rebuilding: New and remanufactured clutches, including clutch rebuilding and relining of clutch discs.
- Differentials: Remanufactured differentials for medium and heavy duty trucks.
- Truck friction bands and brake shoes: Friction bands and brake shoes for trucks.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
A: Yes. Our rapid turnaround service includes free pickup and delivery.

Q: What kinds of vehicles and equipment do you work on?
A: We focus on medium and heavy duty trucks, and we also provide brake friction services for off-highway equipment and industrial customers.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we are open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you have resale and exemption forms?
A: Yes. We have a Certificate of Resale, a Rolling Stock Certificate, an Equipment Exemption Certificate and a credit application available.
